summary: The 8-K filed by UBS Commercial Mortgage Trust 2018-C11 reports a routine servicing transfer under the BANK 2018-BNK13 PSA: Mount Street US (Georgia) LLP was removed as special servicer of the Griffin Portfolio II Mortgage Loan (3.1% of the pool) and Torchlight Loan Services, LLC appointed as successor. No acquisition, divestiture, restructuring, or other special situation is involved. The filing is a contractual servicing update, not a corporate event affecting the trust's structure.
